subject.title: fix(secrets): collect persona-level TTS provider SecretRefs

question: Should persona TTS SecretRef collection land under the current fail-fast startup contract, or wait for the optional-TTS missing-secret policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101265?
rationale: This fix correctly discovers persona credentials, but that discovery can turn previously nonfunctional-yet-startable configurations into Gateway startup failures; code correctness cannot choose the intended upgrade behavior.

options.title: Sequence with optional TTS handling
options.body: Land this after or together with the narrowly approved optional-TTS startup behavior so newly discovered missing persona refs do not take down unrelated Gateway capabilities.

options.title: Accept fail-fast now
options.body: Merge this first and explicitly own startup failure as the intended current contract, backed by exact-head fresh-install and upgrade proof.

options.title: Pause pending policy
options.body: Keep the PR open until the startup-policy discussion reaches a clear maintainer decision and proof plan.

recommendation.title: Sequence with optional TTS handling
recommendation.body: Land this after or together with the narrowly approved optional-TTS startup behavior so newly discovered missing persona refs do not take down unrelated Gateway capabilities.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged the foundational SecretRef architecture and is the strongest available owner for its startup and upgrade contract.
